Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-H, difficulty: medium).

Informal statement:
Let H be a subgroup of G with index n. Prove that there is a normal subgroup K of G contained in H such that the index of K in G is at most n factorial.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fateh_001_subgroup_normal_index_le_factorial {G : Type} [Group G] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial

Use the typed subgoal tools to decompose, verify, review, and route. For this medium task, define four to six concrete compile-verifiable artifacts; do not use vague understand/find/investigate subgoals. Build at least two work subgoals plus one final integration subgoal; use sequential dependencies when the mathematics is sequential. Do not use HANDOFF or VERDICT text markers. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

    rw [h1]
    calc

    have h2 : Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ≠ 0 := by
      -- The range is a subgroup, so it contains at least the identity

    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove K.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    -- The image is non-empty because it contains the identity
    have h2 : Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ≠ 0 := by
      -- The range is a subgroup, so it contains at least the identity
      have h3 : 0 < Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
        apply Nat.card_pos
        · exact Subgroup.nonempty_range _
        · -- Need to show the range is finite
          -- The range is a subgroup of Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H), which is finite
          apply Finite.of_finite_of_le
          · exact Subgroup.finite_quotient_of_finiteIndex H
          · exact MonoidHom.range_le_top
      exact Nat.pos_ne_zero h3
    rw [h1]
    exact h2
  · -- Prove K.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      -- The range is a subgroup of Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)
      apply Subgroup.card_le_of_le
      exact MonoidHom.range_le_top
    have h3 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = Nat.factorial (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)) := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = H.index := by
      rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
    have h5 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      rw [h4, hH]
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = Nat.factorial n := by
      rw [h3, h5]
    rw [h1]
    calc
      Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := h2
      _ = Nat.factorial n := h6","subgoal_id":"sg1","purpose":"subgoal"}

    (H : Subgroup G) (hH : H.index = n) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup G, K.Normal ∧ K ≤ H ∧ K.index ≠ 0 ∧ K.index ≤ n.factorial := by
  use H.normalCore
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_normal H
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.normalCore_le H
  constructor
  · -- Prove H.normalCore.index ≠ 0
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    -- G ⧸ H is finite because H has finite index
    have h2 : Finite (G ⧸ H) := Subgroup.finite_quotient_of_finiteIndex H
    -- Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H) is finite because G ⧸ H is finite
    have h3 : Finite (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := Finite.perm h2
    -- The range is a subgroup of Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H), so it is finite
    have h4 : Finite (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      apply Subgroup.instFiniteSubtypeMem
      exact h3
    -- The range is non-empty (it contains the identity)
    have h5 : Nonempty (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      exact Subgroup.nonempty_range _
    -- Therefore, the cardinality is positive
    have h6 : 0 < Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      apply Nat.card_pos
      · exact h5
      · exact h4
    rw [h1]
    rw [← pos_iff_ne_zero]
    exact h6
  · -- Prove H.normalCore.index ≤ n.factorial
    have h1 : H.normalCore.index = Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) := by
      rw [Subgroup.normalCore_eq_ker]
      rw [Subgroup.index_ker]
    have h2 : Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := by
      apply Subgroup.card_le_of_le
      exact MonoidHom.range_le_top
    have h3 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = Nat.factorial (Nat.card (G ⧸ H)) := by
      rw [Nat.card_perm]
    have h4 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = H.index := by
      rw [Subgroup.index_eq_card]
    have h5 : Nat.card (G ⧸ H) = n := by
      rw [h4, hH]
    have h6 : Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) = Nat.factorial n := by
      rw [h3, h5]
    rw [h1]
    calc
      Nat.card (MonoidHom.range (MulAction.toPermHom G (G ⧸ H))) ≤ Nat.card (Equiv.Perm (G ⧸ H)) := h2
      _ = Nat.factorial n := h6","subgoal_id":"sg1","purpose":"subgoal"}
